clue.text: Supporter first touring continent with musical composition

indicators.note: first asks for only the opening letter of the word that follows it

blocks.note: a supporter of a team is a fan

explanation.surface: A fan travelling around a continent while carrying along a piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: Fantasia is a free-form musical piece, as in Beethoven's Choral Fantasia or Disney's film of that name.

clue.text: Pull upward

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means reading the letters from bottom to top

blocks.note: the tail end of the word, its last four letters

explanation.surface: An instruction to tug something upwards.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay is buried inside one word: upward splits into up, the signal, and ward, which read upward in the grid becomes the answer DRAW.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw a cart or curtain is to pull it along or across, a standard synonym.

clue.text: Box adding weight to vehicle

indicators.note: adding one thing to another means placing them side by side in sequence

blocks.note: a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A box that makes a van heavier once loaded.
explanation.definitionFit: A carton is a cardboard container, a kind of box for goods such as milk or eggs.

clue.text: Appropriate to see mother in green, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the word given is only one possible version, so its letters may be rearranged
in places one piece inside the other

blocks.note: ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Is it fitting to visit Mum while being so inexperienced?
explanation.definitionFit: Germane means relevant or pertinent to a matter, so it is fitting in that sense.

clue.text: Possibility of help about spring

blocks.note: a spring is the source of a stream

explanation.surface: Wondering whether assistance might arrive around springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: A resource is something one can draw on for support when needed, a potential means of aid.

clue.text: Side needing actual capital

explanation.surface: A team that needs genuine funds to compete.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital looks like money, but it is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Real Madrid is a famous Spanish football club, and a side is a sports team.

clue.text: Bird with sound means of propulsion?

indicators.note: sound tells us to go by how the word is spoken rather than its spelling

blocks.note: fuel that drives a car, said out loud

explanation.surface: A bird with an excellent way of propelling itself through the air.
explanation.walkthrough: Sound looks like the adjective meaning good or reliable, but it signals a homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: The petrel is a seabird, such as the storm petrel, that skims low over the ocean.

clue.text: Posture in support of gun

blocks.note: first meaning: the way a person holds their body
second meaning: the wheeled frame on which a cannon is mounted

explanation.surface: A soldier's stance while propping up a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Carriage means bearing or deportment, and a gun carriage is the mount on which an artillery piece rests.

clue.text: Eastern loch side

blocks.note: E is the standard abbreviation for east
Loch Leven is a lake in Scotland

explanation.surface: Describing the east bank of a Scottish lake.
explanation.walkthrough: Side looks like the shore of the loch, but it is the definition: a team.
explanation.definitionFit: A football or cricket team fields eleven players, so a side is often called an eleven.

clue.text: Worry about moderate Tories getting back

indicators.note: getting back suggests going backwards, so the letters run in the reverse direction

blocks.note: wets was the Thatcher-era nickname for moderate Conservatives

explanation.surface: Fretting over centrist Conservatives regaining power.
explanation.walkthrough: Tories are members of Britain's Conservative Party; the moderate wing was dismissed as wets in the 1980s.
explanation.definitionFit: To stew is to fret or brood anxiously over something, an informal synonym of worrying.

clue.text: Silly behaviour causes collapse of Tory mole

indicators.note: something that collapses falls to pieces, so these letters are jumbled

blocks.note: the letters taken as written, ready to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Foolish antics bring down a Conservative spy.
explanation.walkthrough: The word of belongs to the fodder, not the linking; a Tory is a British Conservative.
explanation.definitionFit: Tomfoolery means foolish or playful nonsense, a direct synonym for daft conduct.

clue.text: Like bird's behind

blocks.note: as means in the manner of

explanation.surface: Something resembling a bird's rear end.
explanation.walkthrough: The bird's behind looks like anatomy, but behind is the definition and the apostrophe s means is.
explanation.definitionFit: Astern is a nautical term for at or towards the back of a ship.

clue.text: New inquest re a man on horseback

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh version, so the letters following are remade into another word

explanation.surface: A fresh inquiry concerning a rider.
explanation.definitionFit: An equestrian is a rider of horses, someone mounted on a horse.

clue.text: In most cases, helper follows rule

indicators.note: follows says the first piece named comes after the second one

blocks.note: a norm is a standard or rule

explanation.surface: Usually an assistant obeys the regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: Normally means usually or as a general practice, true in the majority of instances.

clue.text: University dons wrong to include college head

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter
to include means to take something inside

explanation.surface: Academics at a university are mistaken to admit the principal of a college.
explanation.definitionFit: The faculty is the teaching staff of a university, the body of academic dons.

clue.text: Change fish for plant

explanation.surface: Swap a fish for a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Turnsole is a name for heliotrope and similar flowers that turn to follow the sun.

clue.text: Abstain from repetitive strain

blocks.note: first meaning: hold back from doing something
second meaning: a recurring line or tune in a song

explanation.surface: Avoiding a workplace injury caused by repeated motion.
explanation.walkthrough: Repetitive strain suggests the wrist injury, but strain here is a musical phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To refrain is to hold back or desist, and a refrain is the chorus repeated in a song.

clue.text: Fighting sloth?

blocks.note: first meaning: engaged in combat, split as two words

explanation.walkthrough: Split into two words, the answer reads in action, which is what fighting soldiers are; as one word it means idleness.
explanation.definitionFit: Inaction is idleness or lethargy, while troops engaged in battle are described as being in action.

clue.text: Waved goodbye to, when forced to leave

blocks.note: first meaning: accompanied someone to their departure
second meaning: chased away an intruder

explanation.surface: Bidding farewell to someone who was being thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: To see someone off is to bid them farewell at a station, or to drive away an opponent.

clue.text: Explain, in other words, how trick is authentic

blocks.note: a con is a swindle or trick

explanation.surface: Putting into different words how a deception turns out to be genuine.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the wordplay as con's true: the trick is authentic.
explanation.definitionFit: To construe is to interpret or explain the meaning of words or actions.

clue.text: Started with writer buried in a dictionary

indicators.note: something buried in another thing lies inside it

blocks.note: a pen is a writing implement

explanation.surface: An author who began by poring over a dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Opened means began or commenced, as when a play opens or a meeting is started.

clue.text: One, we hear, who interferes with fruit

indicators.note: we hear points to how a word is spoken, not written

explanation.surface: A busybody tampering with the fruit bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: The medlar is a small brown fruit, eaten when half-rotten, from a tree of the rose family.

clue.text: Accident caused by his misreading chart cover

indicators.note: misreading a word gets its letters wrong, so they are rearranged
to cover is to go around the outside of something

explanation.surface: A navigator's mishap from misreading a chart's cover.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap is an unlucky accident, a small mischance or misfortune.

clue.text: Makes out traveller considers himself ill-used

blocks.note: a rep is a travelling salesman

explanation.surface: A salesman pleads that he feels hard done by.
explanation.walkthrough: Makes out is the definition, meaning claims or alleges.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent something as true is to claim or portray it so, as in making out a case.

clue.text: Part of repeat order to bring back cycle

indicators.note: part of means only a section of the words is used
bringing something back means running it in the opposite direction

explanation.surface: Repeating an order in order to return a bicycle.
explanation.walkthrough: Cycle suggests a bike, but it is a recurring sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: A rota is a rotating schedule of duties, a cycle in which people take turns.

clue.text: Cost of extra term

indicators.note: of here means taken from within, so a section of the next words is used

explanation.surface: The price of a further school term.
explanation.definitionFit: A rate is a price or charge, as in the going rate for a service.

clue.text: Remember getting ring back

explanation.surface: Remembering to return a missed phone call.
explanation.walkthrough: Ring back is British for returning a telephone call.
explanation.definitionFit: To recall is to bring something back to mind, and also to call again on the phone.

clue.text: Part played by king during contentious party

indicators.note: during places one thing in the middle of another

blocks.note: a dissenting group within a party
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A role taken by a monarch at a quarrelsome celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: Part played suggests a theatrical role, but part alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraction is a portion or part of a whole, as in a small fraction of the cost.
